read.thesis: Q4 2024 call: PPG guides 2025 adjusted EPS $7.75–$8.05 with low-single-digit organic growth, but Q1 volumes negative; Industrial Coatings near trough with $100M share wins and capex still elevated at $750M.

capex.quote: CapEx at $750 million for 2025, cited as above the company's long-term aspiration due to catch-up and targeted organic growth investments.

triggers.label: Competitor S. American exit supports share gain
triggers.quote: roughly half attributed to a competitor's South American exit

triggers.label: Positive pricing low-single-digit for 2025
triggers.quote: we're expecting positive pricing, low-single digit positive pricing for the company across the board

triggers.label: Q1 2025 volume negative
triggers.quote: we're expecting negative volume -- similar trend to what we saw in Q4

triggers.label: Capex to normalise to ~3% of sales
triggers.quote: you should think about 3% of sales as a normal run rate CapEx for us

guidance.quote: we expect to deliver adjusted earnings per share for the full-year in 2025 in the range of $7.75 to $8.05
We expect to deliver organic sales growth of low-single-digit percentage for the year
the first quarter organic growth flat to slightly down
This program, excuse me, will deliver approximately $175 million once fully implemented, including savings of $60 million in 2025.
we're deploying about $400 million towards share repurchases during the first quarter 2025

red_flags.label: Industrial margin down 160bp in Q4 on index pricing
red_flags.quote: Segment EBITDA margin reduced 160 basis points for the quarter

red_flags.label: Europe architectural volumes declining
red_flags.quote: Sales volumes declined due to weak consumer confidence

evasions.quote: So we have to decide right price, right time.
